narr: Despite the high pressure centered more over western New Mexico, an abundant amount of moisture still resided within the atmosphere. This led to scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms across much of the central and western New Mexico, some of which produced very heavy rainfall. Flash flooding and even a report of large hail was reported across portions of central New Mexico.
ev: A COOP observer near Villanueva reported that the heavy rain caused flooding with water over roadways within the village. No damage was reported.
A member of the public reported that the intersection of Spring Drive SE and Black Hills Road SE near Cabezon was underwater from fast flowing flood waters. No damages were reported.
Heavy rain caused 4 to 6 inches of fast moving water to impact the intersection of Frost and Broken Arrow near Sedillo. No damages were reported.

Heavy rain over the Calf Canyon burn scar during the afternoon drained towards the Las Vegas area through the evening hours. An inebriated motorcyclist attempted to cross a flooded low water crossing at Gallinas Creek and El Llano Road in Las Vegas, but had to be rescued when they failed. Any potential injuries to the motorcyclist are unknown. Timing of this event is a rough estimate given radar. Damages are estimated.
